runtime: node 22, express 4, ws; PostgreSQL 18 via openvibe-sdk/db (pg, or embedded PGlite in tests); Valkey optional; no build step
deployment: Production at https://openvibe.bot on openvibe-ovh since 2026-10-02: release layout /opt/openvibe.bot, unit openvibe-bot.service (WorkingDirectory /opt/openvibe.bot, EnvironmentFile /etc/openvibe/bot.env, PORT 4630, TimeoutStopSec 10), behind the nginx vhost deploy/nginx/openvibe.bot.conf, deployed with `ov deploy bot`. Liveness /api/health and readiness /api/ready are loopback-only.
features: device WebSocket /device: one outbound socket per machine, credential or Network node token, heartbeat and telemetry, commands never replayed after a reconnect
operator WebSocket /control and the REST API (/api/v1) over one command gate: roles, per-robot limits and allowlists, cooldowns and the turn budget
pairing with one-time codes, minted by Bot or delegated to OpenVibe.Network (BOT_PAIRING_AUTHORITY=network); a node machine binds on first use and reauths every 300 s
device credentials hashed at rest and rotatable; revoke closes the socket at once and revokes the Network principal for a node machine
profiles instead of per-robot rows: adeept.adr036 (+ mecanum variant), cozmo, camera.onvif, sim.rover, seeded from server/profiles/*.json
a latched e-stop only the owner clears, with halt always allowed, and a device-side deadman deadline on the motion kinds
command audit kept 30 days, and the bot.robot.online/offline, bot.estop.set/cleared and bot.command.refused outbox events
public robot-profile catalogue (GET /profiles, /profiles/:id); robots are private to their owner, with public control only as a timed turn queue
per-actor limits on capability-boundary writes (openvibe-sdk/limits; shared through Valkey when VALKEY_URL is set)
